subject: Final MAP endorsement + signature cadence (start date options)
messages:
From: Alex Morgan <alex@starlighthq.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@starlighthq.com>; procurement@starlighthq.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timeline — final questions

Ben — thanks for the updated MAP and the evaluation plan. We're excited to move forward but need a quick alignment on the final approval path and exact signature timing so our internal launch committee can lock a start date. A few items from our side:

- Signers: Procurement will countersign, then our CIO (public-facing) signs for go-live commitments. Can you confirm the expected routing order on your side?
- Start date options: we prefer 2027-04-04 (preferred) or 2027-04-18 as a fallback. Can Redwood commit to onboarding ramp and the initial performance eval window to accommodate either date?
- Minor SOW question: section 2.3 references a 2‑week integration window — procurement wants to know if that precludes parallel work on our side.

We can do a short call today (30m) if helpful. Otherwise please reply with the routing + signature windows and we'll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Alex Morgan
Head of Strategic Programs
Starlight Retail

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Morgan <alex@starlighthq.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; monica_patel@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@starlighthq.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timeline — final questions

Alex — great to hear. Short answers up front, then a concise routing + timing plan below.

Quick answers:
- Routing/order: Starlight signs -> Redwood Sales (me) ack -> Redwood Legal signoff (Laura) -> Redwood Executive endorsement (Karthik) -> final e-sign from Redwood operations. We can flip internal order if you need procurement first.
- Start date: We can commit to either 2027-04-04 or 2027-04-18 provided the DocuSign cycle closes by 2027-03-24 for the earlier date.
- Integration window: Section 2.3 is optimistic; the 2-week window assumes parallel workstreams (your infra team onboarding while our infra engineers provision the dedicated instance). We can update language to explicitly allow parallel tasks.

Suggested signature cadence (timeline):
1) 2027-03-08 to 2027-03-11 — Final redline window (legal comments due)
2) 2027-03-12 to 2027-03-16 — Internal approvals and exec endorsement at Redwood
3) 2027-03-17 to 2027-03-24 — DocuSign routing and countersign (aim to finish by 03/24 for Apr 4 start)
4) 2027-04-04 — Target go-live (preferred)
Fallback: finish DocuSign by 04/07 for an Apr 18 go-live.

Attachments: I attached the MAP_Starlight_v3.pdf (finalized milestones + owner matrix), EvaluationPlan_Starlight.xlsx (metrics/traffic shape and evaluation schedule), and an initial SOW (SOW_Starlight_v1.docx).

Laura — can you confirm Redwood's legal can complete the standard review within the March 12–16 window if Starlight returns redlines by March 11?

Monica — please confirm the onboarding runbook and the 2-week parallel assumption — any constraints on our side?

Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call if you prefer.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai; Alex Morgan <alex@starlighthq.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@starlighthq.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 13:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timeline — final questions

Alex / Ben — I reviewed the MAP and SOW. Two small asks so procurement can clear quickly: 

1) Liability cap: Can we make the cap explicitly aligned to one quarter of committed spend for the pilot (instead of a flat number)? This is an acceptable commercial change for many customers and shortens procurement review.
2) Section 4.1 (Third-party subprocessing): Add an explicit clause that Redwood will notify Starlight 30 days prior to adding a subprocessor that will handle live customer data. Procurement flagged this as a requirement.

If Starlight agrees to those two edits we can run the internal approval and sign during the March 17–24 DocuSign window Ben outlined. If Starlight cannot accept, please flag and we can escalate to Kar (cc'd) for exec approval.

For the SOW timing note: the integration team (Monica) confirms we will run provisioning in parallel with your infra onboarding; the 2-week "integration" refers to the final alignment and validation. Monica — short confirmation below?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Morgan <alex@starlighthq.com>; ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@starlighthq.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft and timeline — final questions

Alex — quick confirmation from onboarding: we can run provisioning in parallel with Starlight's infra tasks. Practical notes:

- Pre-reqs for Apr 4 go-live: network peering and a test dataset upload need to be complete by 2027-03-29 to allow the 4 business days of performance tuning we schedule after provisioning.
- If DocuSign completes by 2027-03-24, we have band to meet Apr 4. If signing extends beyond that, we should target Apr 18 and use the extra two weeks for a staged roll (pilot cohort + ramp).

Laura — on the liability cap we can accept the quarter-of-spend model for the pilot. Alex / Procurement — if you confirm acceptance of the two legal edits by end-of-day 2027-03-11 we will lock the internal approvals and commit to the DocuSign window.

Action items summarized:
- Starlight: agree to two legal edits (liability cap model + subprocessor notification) by 2027-03-11.
- Ben/Redwood: circulate final DocuSign packet by 2027-03-12.
- Procurement: confirm signer list and routing order by 2027-03-11.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Onboarding Engineer, Redwood Inference
